claim_supported.instructions: Does the provided verified evidence support every material part of this atomic claim, with its stated conditions?

criteria.false: Unsupported or contradicted; this does not mean objectively false.

brand_fit.instructions: Does this content match the supplied brand tone, promise and audience?

criteria.false: Violates a material required brand condition.

offer_transparent.instructions: Does the draft accurately communicate verified price, extra charges, scope and conditions?

criteria.true: All material purchase conditions are represented accurately.
criteria.false: A material condition is missing or inconsistent.

lead_fit.instructions: Which fit level is supported by the supplied lead needs and qualification criteria?

criteria.fit: All required needs and qualification criteria match.

content_quality.instructions: Rate clarity and usefulness against the supplied content brief.
criteria: Confusing, no relevant value or action.
Some value but important ambiguity or weak action.
Clear customer value, evidence and appropriate next action.
